title: Batch A, part 2: Marta, Tull, Thimble, Gullwake
summary: Batch A, part 2 is done: all six subjects approved by Dylan on 2026-11-08 (the Gullwake sheet and deck plan after one redo each). Tap any picture to see it full size.

items.name: Marta Oake

zooms.label: Faces, all four views
zooms.why: Reads 61, olive skin, grey hair under the blue headscarf; small closed smile

zooms.label: Back view
zooms.why: Scarf knot and bun at the back of the head; apron bow at the waist

notes: Small closed smile rather than a flat neutral mouth
Boots are lace-up rather than plain ankle boots
passed: 2 no text; the shawl's cable knit is a pattern
13 back of the head seen from behind

zooms.label: Back view

items.name: Thimble

zooms.label: Heads and bell
zooms.why: Snout shape, stub horns, eyes; cracked brass bell in every view

zooms.label: Back view
zooms.why: Strap over the neck; the tail hangs over the rump instead of pointing at us (19)

notes: The snout reads as a broad cow or hippo muzzle more than a spade
Back-view tail hangs down over the rump (19)
passed: 9 bell under the chin in front and both sides, strap over the neck in back

items.name: Thimble as a Hollow

zooms.label: Core, cables and plates
zooms.why: Core set into the chest; only a sliver of glow in the side views (9, 10)

zooms.label: Back view
zooms.why: Spine and shoulder plates; no core showing; tail

notes: Hair reads dull grey-beige more than grey-green
Sad more than menacing, with finer lines than the bear (18)
Take 1 came out 1774x887 (fix 16); resized, no new drawing

items.name: Gullwake, four views
items.take: take 3 (edit of take 1: yards and red patch)

zooms.label: Bow view yards
zooms.why: Three yards seen full width (fore yard behind, main lower and upper); red patch at the LEFT end of the lowest

zooms.label: Side views
zooms.why: Yards now seen end-on as short stubs: one on the fore mast, two on the main, none on the Post; red patch only on the near end in the right-side view

zooms.label: Stern view yards
zooms.why: Same three yards full width; red patch at the RIGHT end

notes: The fore yard in the bow and stern views sits a little higher than its stub in the side views
passed: 18b yards square across the ship, matching count and height in every view
18b red patch on the main lower yard's starboard end in every view that faces it
17 hull, deck items and colours unchanged by eye
